# Independent Set73 wallet reference producer

This is a source-only candidate until the parent root reviews the exact source
and input lock and sets `approved_by` to `root` and `execution_authorized` to
`true`. Authoring, JSON inventory reads and AST syntax parsing do not execute
these models. No expected output has been generated by this candidate.

The input catalog records exact adopted contracts, committed Set72 public
references, and the independently generated/reproduced Set73 public carrier
corpus. Every copied file has a hash and source provenance. Only already
published fixture material is present. Modeled IDs, clock samples, tips,
original-manifest cursor variants and fault cases are visibly labeled. Do not
substitute a Go-produced expected value or a private wallet/export/DB.

`generate_reference.py` checks the complete safe input set and exact source
lock before importing any model. It independently recomputes the existing
carrier vectors, derives public paths from the old public branch keys, and
uses the reviewed independent carrier arithmetic for the separately approved
sixteen32000-atom-input case, including both exact signed legs. The600000-atom
sixteen-input carrier fixture remains codec-only; it is not claimed as a
smallest sufficient wallet selection. Output bytes are canonical independent
JSON plus one final LF for the corpus container. Nested canonical codec
strings contain no LF. Marker models show canonical object bytes; their file
framing adds exactly one LF as specified by the contract.

Case names/counts are locked before outcomes. Negative verdicts use only
`refuse`, not new invented product sentinel categories. Source errors or
unexpected acceptance terminate the attempt; external runners must retain
its failure and unchanged source/input bindings rather than rewriting it to
match implementation results. The sizing result consists of conservative
grammar bounds and independently recomputed transaction layout arithmetic;
it does not claim every conservative envelope is a valid transaction.

After approval, run without a network or Go process:

```
python3 generate_reference.py --execute --input-root inputs \
  --input-catalog input-catalog.json \
  --approved-producer-lock execution-lock.approved.json \
  --approved-lock-sha256 EXACT_REVIEWED_SHA --output FRESH_DIRECTORY
```

Run a second installed Python with the same lock into another fresh directory
and compare `wallet-v1.json` byte-for-byte. `reproduce.py` automates that one
bounded invocation and exact comparison against an independently retained
expected file; it never imports the model or replaces expectations. Archived
reproduction must work from these relative files with no workspace or temp
dependencies. Application filesystem durability, account reset, concrete
ownership/capability checks, allocation commit/rollback, cancellation and
private-key cleanup require separate implementation tests.
